room_to_win.label: Constrained room
room_to_win.directionality: Higher means more room to win; exact inverse of Competitive Pressure Index.
room_to_win.rounding_method: Exact integer inversion after the Competitive Pressure Index is rounded: 100 - 57 = 43.
room_to_win.decision_rationale: Room to Win is the exact inversion of the unchanged Competitive Pressure Index: 100 - 57 = 43. It is not independently banded.
room_to_win.limitation: Any future change to Competitive Pressure must produce an equal and opposite change here.
